scope: Proposition 9.2 (Triangular observable and the crossing coefficient) of the manuscript “Cardy’s formula for critical Poisson–Voronoi percolation” (preprints/Cardys-formula-for-critical-Poisson-Voronoi-percolation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 224 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1334302b31272ae0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 66. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The value Fη m belongs to the closed triangle with vertices w0, w1, w2. At a fan probe siu, where u is interior to the boundary arc vivi+1, it belongs to the side [wi, wi+1]. For i = 0 and u the marked vertex approximating b, the coefficient of w1 on this side is exactly the free black vertex crossing probability between the arcs approximating ab and cd in the original disk.
